system.description: Mele: You conjure up an enormous blazing sun, streaks to your target and strikes him for S + WP damage. As above, plus additional damage wound. The target’s armour soak value is ignored against this blessing. WA + Fel damage. Each enemy within medium range is Blinded for 2 rounds. Suffer 1 stress and 1 fatigue. Gain the Blinded condition for 2 rounds. Gain 3 favour immediately.
